Definition: from G575 and G4864; excommunicated:--(put) out of the synagogue(-s).
BiblicalUsage: This is the word for being put out of the synagogue, excommunicated from the community. The healed blind man's parents feared it because the Jews had agreed to cast out anyone who confessed Jesus as Christ, many rulers believed but would not confess for fear of it, and Jesus warned His disciples that the day would come when being cast out would be counted as service to God.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the fear of being cast out is one of the oldest pressures on faith. The rulers who believed in secret show how costly open confession can feel, and the blind man shows what it looks like to pay the price anyway.
